scripts.setup: cd backend && uv sync && uv run alembic upgrade head && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --reload-dir app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.test: cd backend && uv run pytest -q && cd ../frontend && npm test
scripts.migrate: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.gen:api: cd backend && uv run python -m app.dump_openapi ../frontend/openapi.json && cd ../frontend && npx -y openapi-typescript@7 openapi.json -o src/lib/api-types.ts && node -e "require('fs').unlinkSync('openapi.json')"
